title: Disassembly Wizard — Intermediate Representation (IR)
description: The contract between the load phase and the output generators (PDF, TXT, MD, HTML+JS, PPTX, DOCX, VIDEO). One linearized disassembly guide derived from a Builder graph. Versioned via schema_version; the load phase keeps this shape stable. 1.1: every step declares its `input` (the piece the operation is performed on), `continues_as` lists ALL continuing composites, and the guide carries a top-level `tools` union (FR 1.3).

schema_version.description: 1.2 adds optional resolved material_details; 1.1 inputs remain supported.

depth.description: The disassembly depth that was applied when producing this guide.

tools.description: Every tool used across the whole guide: the union of the steps' tools_required, de-duplicated case-insensitively, in first-appearance order. Render it at the top of your output next to the bill of materials; you never need to recompute it.

steps.description: The disassembly operations, in execution order. Iterate this in order to render the guide.

warnings.description: Validation findings. The guide is produced even when warnings exist; surfacing them to the user is recommended but never required.

bill_of_materials.description: Flat list of the final leaf parts (null if it was not requested). Weights sum to the product weight when all weights are known.

image.description: An image reference, or null when the node has no image. The path is passed through unchanged from the source; is_url tells you whether to fetch a remote URL or load a local/relative path.

component.description: A part: the product, an extracted output, a kept-whole block, or a BoM line. Optional fields are present but may be null.

node_id.description: Source node id, for cross-referencing back to the original model.

weight.description: Numeric weight, or null if unknown.

kept_whole.description: True if this is a sub-assembly the user chose to keep intact (depth cut), rather than a natural final part.

contained_leaf_count.description: For a kept-whole block, how many leaf parts are hidden inside it; null otherwise.

action.description: One atomic instruction in a step's ordered instruction chain (the 'how').

tools.description: Tool(s) for this instruction as the source gave them (may be a comma-separated list), or null. The step-level tools_required is the split, de-duplicated form.

step.description: One disassembly operation. Narration: take `input`, perform `operation` following `actions` in order, obtain `outputs`; each entry of `continues_as` is opened by a LATER step — the one whose input.node_id matches. Steps are ordered depth-first (one branch completed before the next), so do not assume the next step in the list continues the current one: the `input` field is the reliable link.

index.description: 1-based position in the global execution order.

input.description: The component this operation is performed ON: the product for a starting step, a continuing composite afterwards.

actions.description: The ordered instruction chain for this operation.

outputs.description: The parts produced by this operation (final leaves and any kept-whole blocks).

continues_as.description: ALL composites that carry the disassembly forward, in descent order (a disassembly may branch). Empty when this branch is finished — which does not mean the guide is over.

tools_required.description: De-duplicated (case-insensitive) union of the tools used across this step's actions, split on ','; when the actions carry no tools (a self-explanatory operation), the operation's own aggregate tools are used instead.

warning.description: A validation finding localized to specific node(s).

rule.description: Stable identifier of the rule that fired.

severity.description: Gravity. All severities are non-blocking; the guide is still produced.

node_ids.description: Source id(s) of the affected element(s).

mode.description: full = fully disassembled; keep_main = main assemblies kept whole; manual = specific nodes kept whole.

keep_whole_ids.description: For manual mode, the node ids kept whole; empty otherwise.
